title: Cannot reach the shared drive

character.name: Shoaib
character.personality: calm, needs reports for a meeting

symptom: Mapped shared drive shows a red cross and will not open
user_description: My S: drive has a red cross on it and says the network path can't be found. Yesterday it was fine.

options.text: Copy the files to a USB drive for him and close the ticket
options.why: A workaround that leaves the drive broken and moves company files onto removable media.

options.text: Give him administrator rights on the server
options.why: Far too much access, and permissions are not the first suspect for a path that cannot be found.

options.text: Check he is on the office network or VPN, see whether the internet and other shares work, then test the path using the server name and re-map the drive
options.why: 'Path not found' usually means he cannot reach the server. Checking his connection, testing other resources and the server name and re-mapping narrows the cause step by step.
Never the first step. It is destructive and does not address a network path.

hints: Can he reach anything else on the network?
What does 'path not found' tell you about where the problem is?
How could you check the server name is right?
real_world_tip: If other people can open the same drive, the fault is on his PC or connection, not on the server.
